abstract:
PURPOSE: To determine the diagnostic performance and interobserver agreement of MRI for differentiating mucinous from non-mucinous pancreatic cystic lesions (PCLs) and identifying advanced neoplasia using surgical pathology as the reference standard.
METHODS: This retrospective single-center study included surgically resected PCLs with preoperative MRI (2019-2025). Three independent readers blindly assessed cyst subtype and imaging features, including worrisome features (WF) and high-risk stigmata (HRS) according to the 2024 Kyoto guideline. Consensus interpretation was established with a fourth senior abdominal radiologist. Diagnostic performance for mucinous lesion characterization and advanced neoplasia (high-grade dysplasia and invasive carcinoma) was evaluated. Interobserver agreement was assessed using Fleiss κ and Gwet AC1. Logistic regression and ROC analyses identified imaging predictors of advanced neoplasia.
RESULTS: A total of 85 patients were included (mean age, 66.8 ± 12.5 years; 50.6 % female). At pathology, 70/85 lesions (82.4 %) were mucinous and 23/85 (27.1 %) represented advanced neoplasia, including 21 high-grade dysplasia and two IPMN-derived PDAC. MRI consensus interpretation achieved 100 % sensitivity, 80 % specificity, and 96.5 % accuracy for identifying mucinous lesions. MRI demonstrated 52.2 % sensitivity and 67.7 % specificity for advanced neoplasia using WF or HRS, whereas HRS alone improved specificity (95.2 %) at the expense of sensitivity (21.7 %). All readers correctly identified both cases of IPMN-derived PDAC. Interobserver agreement for cyst subtype classification was fair by Fleiss κ but substantial by Gwet AC1, whereas agreement for detecting advanced neoplasia was moderate. Main pancreatic duct diameter independently predicted advanced neoplasia (OR, 1.18; 95 % CI, 1.01-1.38; p = 0.042) and outperformed cyst size (AUC, 0.69 vs 0.56).
CONCLUSION: In this surgically selected cohort, consensus MRI differentiates mucinous from nonmucinous PCLs with high sensitivity. Detection of advanced neoplasia, particularly noninvasive high-grade dysplasia, remains challenging because of overlap with low-grade lesions. Fair-to-moderate interobserver agreement highlights the challenges of MRI-based risk stratification. The surgically selected cohort provides histopathologic confirmation but should be considered when interpreting performance estimates in the broader surveillance population.
key_points_ko: 수술 전 MRI 합의 판독은 점액성 췌장 낭종을 감별하는 데 민감도 100%, 특이도 80%, 정확도 96.5%를 기록했습니다.
진행성 신생물 감별 시 우려 징후(WF) 또는 고위험 징후(HRS) 기준을 사용하면 민감도 52.2%, 특이도 67.7%였고, HRS 단독 적용 시 특이도는 95.2%로 높으나 민감도는 21.7%로 떨어졌습니다.
주췌관 직경은 진행성 신생물을 독립적으로 예측하는 지표였습니다(교차비 1.18, 95% 신뢰구간 1.01-1.38, p=0.042).
summary_ko: 수술을 받은 췌장 낭성 병변(PCL) 환자 85명을 대상으로 수술 전 자기공명영상(MRI)의 점액성 병변 감별 및 진행성 신생물(고등급 이형성증 및 침윤성 암) 진단 성적을 평가한 후향적 연구입니다. MRI 합의 판독은 점액성 병변을 감별하는 데 민감도 100%, 특이도 80%로 높은 정확도를 보였습니다. 반면 진행성 신생물을 감별할 때 2024년 교토 가이드라인의 '우려 징후(WF)' 또는 '고위험 징후(HRS)' 기준을 적용하면 민감도 52.2%, 특이도 67.7%였으며, HRS 단독 기준은 특이도가 95.2%로 올라갔지만 민감도는 21.7%로 낮아졌습니다. 주췌관 확장은 진행성 신생물을 예측하는 독립적 인자였으나 전반적으로 MRI를 통한 악성도 예측 및 판독자 간 일치도에는 여전히 한계가 있음이 확인되었습니다.
title: Diagnostic performance and interobserver agreement of MRI for pancreatic cystic lesions: a multi-reader study with surgical histopathologic correlation
title_ko: 췌장 낭성 병변에 대한 MRI의 진단 성적 및 판독자 간 일치도: 수술 병리 결과를 기준으로 한 다기관/다수 판독자 연구
